mapper.select: SELECT bc.no, bc.board_no, bc.writer_no, bc.content, bc.accepted_yn, bc.created_date, bc.modified_date, m.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM board_comment bc LEFT JOIN member m ON bc.writer_no = m.no WHERE bc.board_no = #{boardNo} ORDER BY bc.no ASC
SELECT no, board_no, writer_no, content, created_date, modified_date FROM board_comment WHERE no = #{no}
mapper.update: UPDATE board_comment SET content = #{content}, modified_date = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE no = #{no}
